title: Withdrawal of a Vehicle Before Work Starts — Insurance Claim Repairs Terms
content:
1. **Whose decision.** Withdrawing the vehicle from an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order is the customer's decision and is possible only before work starts — from assigned or authorized status.
2. **Consent.** The customer's vehicle withdrawal consent on the repair order is signed, as the system's consent records for that repair order show before the withdrawal is recorded.
3. **Teardown charge.** When a teardown was completed, the customer is charged the class's withdrawal teardown hours at the class's withdrawal labor rate as a withdrawal teardown charge, doubled where the class requires reassembly on withdrawal because the vehicle is put back together before release. No teardown charge applies when none was done.
4. **Deductible and betterment.** On withdrawal every deductible and betterment charge already assessed is credited in full, with the reason "repair withdrawn".
5. **Insurer balance.** One withdrawal reversal adjustment, naming the original-estimate approval, brings the insurer balance to zero; no adjustment posts when it is already zero.
6. **Notices.** The insurer is told of the withdrawal and the Rental Vehicle Coordination partner receives a repair-cancelled notice.

## Status and teardown table

| Status at withdrawal | Teardown completed | Reassembly required in the class | Withdrawal possible | Teardown charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| assigned or authorized | no | any | yes | none |
| assigned or authorized | yes | no | yes | teardown hours at the labor rate |
| assigned or authorized | yes | yes | yes | teardown hours at the labor rate, doubled |
| in repair or later | any | any | no | — |

## Hypothetical withdrawal

A class with 3.0 withdrawal teardown hours, a labor rate of USD 62.00 and reassembly required; teardown completed; a deductible charge of USD 500.00 and a betterment charge of USD 40.00 assessed; insurer balance USD 2,400.00. The teardown charge is 3.0 hours at USD 62.00, USD 186.00, doubled to USD 372.00. The USD 500.00 and USD 40.00 charges are each credited in full, and one withdrawal reversal adjustment of USD 2,400.00 brings the insurer balance to zero.
